prompt: Who was on the British throne when the England Men’s Cricket Team first beat Australia in a Test Series?
answer: Queen Victoria was on the British throne. England first defeated Australia in a Test series during the 1882–83 Ashes, which England won 2–1 under captain Ivo Bligh. Victoria reigned from 1837 to 1901.
